date_note: Tengrinews gives only its publication day (24 November); the page gives no earlier day for the darknet listing.
title: Claim: database said to hold Kazakh citizens' data offered on darknet; ministry says link to government systems unconfirmed
org: Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development (Kazakhstan)
geo_basis: country named by the source; no city given
summary: Tengrinews reports a database said to belong to a Kazakh state body was offered for sale on the darknet. The ministry says the link to government systems is not confirmed and the alleged leak concerns the ЕПСО portal. Minister Zhaslan Madiyev said the Information Security Committee and the KNB are checking, and that such listings often contain "garbage information".
plain: A darknet seller claims to offer a database of Kazakh citizens' data. The minister says it is being checked and such listings often hold garbage information; the link to government systems is unconfirmed.
exec: An unverified darknet sale claim names a Kazakh court-portal database; the ministry says the link to government systems is unconfirmed and is checking.

evidence.quote: «Мусорная информация»: Мадиев высказался об утечке 16,6 млн данных казахстанцев
По данным компании, база включает 507 миллионов записей из 186 таблиц за период с 2014 по 2026 год.
